response.sql: WITH color_totals AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color') as color, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) as total_invoiced FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.product_color, 'No Color')), grand_total AS (SELECT SUM(total_invoiced) as total FROM color_totals), color_analysis AS (SELECT color, total_invoiced, total_invoiced / (SELECT total FROM grand_total) as share, (SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) FROM color_totals) as avg_per_color FROM color_totals), above_average AS (SELECT * FROM color_analysis WHERE total_invoiced > avg_per_color) SELECT AVG(total_invoiced) as avg_invoiced_amount, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(total_invoiced - avg_per_color) as avg_above_average FROM above_average
